name: Git
description: Sistema de control de versiones distribuido más utilizado en el mundo para rastrear cambios en código fuente.

command.windows: if (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements } elseif (Get-Command choco -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { choco install git -y } else { Start-Process 'https://git-scm.com/download/win' }
command.linux: which apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git || which pacman >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo pacman -S --noconfirm git || which dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo dnf install -y git || which zypper >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo zypper install -y git || echo 'Instala git usando el gestor de paquetes de tu distribución'
command.darwin: which brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && brew install git || xcode-select --install || echo 'Instala git vía Homebrew o Xcode Command Line Tools'
